tips.title: Der / Die / Das memory tips
tips.subtitle: Rules to help you guess the German article correctly
tips.learnTip1Desc: Always learn "der Tisch" instead of just "Tisch"
tips.learnTip2Desc: der = blue, die = pink, das = green
tips.learnTip3Desc: Imagine der = a man, die = a woman, das = a baby holding the object
tips.learnTip4Desc: Bundle words with the same ending to lock in the rule
tips.learnTip5Desc: Use the SRS Review feature for long-term retention

ipa.title: German IPA chart
ipa.subtitle: {count} standard phonetic symbols — click to hear an example and see pronunciation tips
ipa.noteBody: An IPA sound on its own can't be pronounced naturally. When you click the speaker icon, the system reads an example word that contains the sound using the Coqui TTS voice (Thorsten) so you hear it in context.
